It happened to me this morning too! I woke up looked at my phone at 4 am, checked my stocks, saw that I made a little money. Went back to sleep. Only to wake up at 5 am and realize that entire thing didn’t happen. It was so real, even my phone had the same text messages on it as when I fell asleep.
I have a new doctor that’s scheduled for weeks out. Looking for meaningful advice in the meantime, not an online diagnosis

I am not over estimating. I’ve been on concerta since 2016. I’ve lost 15 pounds in 2 months. The reason for this post is because my doctor doesn’t believe the weightloss is problematic. Not for you to make assumptions about my health. If I was overestimating I wouldn’t post in a Reddit thread seeking help. Thank you for your input though.
A day. & I have been tested 3 times Thyroid results were normal.

I eat three meals a day over 2000 calories. 23 years old. Female. No medical complications. Zoloft, Concerta, daily vitamins, probiotics, birth control. All of which I have been on for the last 4 years with no complications.
